No Shopping | "No Shopping" is a single by American rapper French Montana, from his mixtape "MC4".  The track features a guest appearance from Toronto-based rapper Drake.  The track was produced by Murda Beatz and Cubeatz.  The song was certified Gold by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) in December 2016, for selling over 500,000 digital copies in the United States.
